description: Send a project introduction directly to Contact with explicit permission. No local files, queue, inbox or inquiry history. Success requires Contact acknowledgement. On failure retry later with the same details; a timeout can leave the remote outcome uncertain. Updates the contact's latest project fields without subscribing them to marketing.

idempotency_key.description: Optional legacy field; no local deduplication history. Contact upserts use email as identity.

summary.description: Summary plus optional timing must fit 255 UTF-8 bytes. Nothing is saved locally.

user_authorized.description: True only after permission to share these details with Santurce Software via Email for project follow-up.

name: submit_project_inquiry
